newsitem.title: USA: Medical Resources buys Wesley Medical.
newsitem.headline: Medical Resources buys Wesley Medical.

text.p: Medical Resources Inc said Wednesday it acquired Wesley Medical Resources Inc, a medical staffing company based in San Francisco, Calif.

Wesley, which will be operated by the company's StarMed Staffing unit, generates annual revenues of $4 million from its locations in San Francisco and Oakland, Calif., and Las Vegas, a Medical Resources news release said.
The company said it acquired Wesley for $2 million payable in Medical Resources common stock plus additional contingent consideration based on Wesley's performance over the next three years.
And StarMed said it opened branch offices in Seattle, San Diego, Bradenton, Fla., and Worcester, Mass., bringing its total number of per diem staffing locations to 25.
Medical Resources specializes in the operation and acquisition of diagnostic imaging centers.
